Two upright horns with deer horns above?

p.note: Excerpts from Alexander de Villa-Dei, Doctrinale, e.g. chapters 12.2.251-262. On : the mnemonic verses on Canon Law: In medio rendi non est spes ulla sciendi and Verum dicebat soluere quisque sciat nate nepos frater dixit nato sua mater ; the letter W, written in a flourished style, also appearing on and ; the phrase Liber generacionis ihesu christi filii dauit.

Scribbles; single words and phrases; verses, for example: Wt corpus redimas ferre paciaris et ignem Est sine principio pater in essentia (the first line, from Ovid's Ars Amatoria, is repeated on bottom of the page). The first letter W, written in a flourished style, appears three times on the page. In red ink the words Liber ecclesie Strengenensis. Siggo archidiaconus scripsit hoc. The words Liber ecclesie Strengenensis are repeated twice in brown ink.
The letter W written in the same style as on . With pencil, in a modern hand: Strängnäs domk. bibl.

binding.p: Repaired after the fire in and rebound in blue paper covers.

provenance.p: Strängnäs Cathedral. A note on SL1r reads: Liber ecclesie strengenensis. Siggo archidiaconus scripsit hoc, written by the archdeacon Sigge Ulfsson Sparre, who held this office 1429–1449.
